name: Glitch name decodes beside a pixel-heart mark
looks: On a dark, faintly gridded field, a small pixel-art heart mark glows above a line of scrambled characters that flicker through random glyphs, some flashing the accent colour, before locking letter by letter into the product's real name.
build: end-card-decode's scramble mechanic: each letter renders a seeded random glyph until its own staggered lock time, then holds its final character; the mark's glow is a slow independent pulse, unrelated to the decode's timing.
sound: Glitch ticks under the decode, resolving into a single soft confirm hit on the last letter's lock.
prompt: Open on a glowing brand mark with its name still glitching, each letter flickering through random characters before locking into place one at a time, so the name itself feels like it is resolving out of noise.
